Eligible students, parents and educators still have a few weeks to take advantage of Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion on select Mac and iPad models. Here's what you need to know.

Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion has been extended to September 24

According to MacRumors, Apple has updated the promotional period for its 2026 back-to-school offer. The original end date was August 27, and it has now been extended to September 24; the promotion originally ran from July 16 through August 27.

This year, in addition to the standard education pricing on Mac and iPad, eligible students who purchase a qualifying Mac or iPad can also receive an Apple gift card valued up to US$150.

Below is the official list from Apple detailing the gift card amount included with each qualifying Mac and iPad purchase:

Product Category Eligible Products Promotion Product Mac MacBook Pro $150 Apple Gift Card Mac MacBook Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Pro $100 Apple Gift Card

According to the terms and conditions of the "2026 Higher Education Student Offer":

Eligible participants in this promotion include faculty, staff, students and parents (collectively referred to as "eligible buyers"), with details as follows: K–12 (kindergarten through high school) — faculty and staff of public and private K–12 institutions in the United States, as well as homeschool teachers, are eligible. In addition, current members of school boards, whether elected or appointed, are also eligible. Current members of the executive committees of parent-teacher associations (PTA or PTO), whether elected or appointed, are also eligible. Higher Education — teaching staff and employees of U.S. higher education institutions, as well as students currently enrolled or admitted, are eligible. Parents of higher education students — parents making purchases on behalf of their children are also eligible, provided their children are currently enrolled or admitted to a public or private U.S. higher education institution. Individual purchases made through the Apple Education Store do not apply to institutional purchases or resale purposes.

If you don't qualify, or the promotion has already ended, you can still find discounts through Apple's official Amazon storefront, with prices even lower than Apple's standard education pricing.

You can also shop at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, where you can save up to 15% (i.e., up to a maximum 15% off) on various products.
